crossRefs.note: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to…
the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
This was their ordering in their service, to come into Yahweh’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron…
of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Abijah
people.line: Head of a priestly division during David's reign

people.name: Elizabeth
people.line: The wife of Zechariah and mother of John the Baptist.

people.name: Herod
people.line: The Great, Roman-appointed king of Judea during Jesus' birth.

people.name: Judea

translations.web: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
translations.bsb: In the time of Herod king of Judea there was a priest named Zechariah, who belonged to the priestly division of Abijah, and whose wife Elizabeth was a descendant of Aaron.
translations.kjv: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
translations.asv: There was in the days of Herod, king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abijah: and he had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
